status: provisional B decision, 27 October, recorded before the weight search; C may revise the lighting ranges or weight candidates, which requires rerunning B1/B2
scope: AD component only; AD 2 feasibility and evaluation remain separate
category_policy: bottle plus the cheapest eligible texture if the complete matrix fits; otherwise bottle only
horizon_rule: Prefer the object-plus-texture matrix at 80 source passes; use 40 if needed to fit measured cost. If neither fits, use the longest feasible bottle-only matrix. Choose before the weight search.
horizon_rationale: Two views at 80 source passes gives 160 input-view passes, matching the single-view reference's input-view count. The 40-pass fallback has half that exposure. All paired controls share the chosen horizon; no equal-compute or equal-optimizer-update claim is made.

weight_search.controls: one B1 run per category at the tuning seed, shared by all candidates; repeats at the same seed are deterministic and would be identical
weight_search.proxy: category-macro mean of B2/B1 normal-validation patch-score MSE ratios at the four fixed brightness/gamma corners
weight_search.tie_rule: smallest positive weight within 1 percent of the best eligible proxy
weight_search.no_eligible_candidate: stop; do not silently change the safeguards or launch B2

selection_note: grid is the cheapest eligible texture by the measured paired step cost; no anomaly scores or test data were read
